GAME BACKGROUND, WIDE 16:9 LANDSCAPE, seen in FIRST PERSON from the eyes of a short man standing (camera at about 1.55 m, looking straight ahead, natural perspective, no fisheye). NO people and NO animals anywhere in the image (characters are added later as separate layers). Detailed clean pixel art, larger flat colour areas, little texture noise. No text, no letters, no logos.
A muddy dirt road through a village in rural Oltenia, Romania, at night in light autumn rain. The road leads straight ahead, with puddles reflecting the lights. LEFT foreground: a concrete electricity pole with a single old street lamp giving weak orange light, tangled wires going to the houses. Both sides: low village houses with tall wooden or metal fences and gates, bare walnut trees, a wooden bench by a gate. RIGHT, at the end of the road (middle distance): a small single-storey village pub, the old collective-farm shop, with a big lit shop window glowing warm yellow and a BLANK sign above the door (no letters). Dark blue cloudy sky, cold moonlight, wet surfaces. Empty area on the road in the left-middle ground (a dog will be added there later).
